dialogue.content: I'll have 12 unused PTO days at the end of 2026. How many of them do I lose, and is there a deadline for using the ones I keep?

With 12 unused PTO days at the end of 2026, you'd lose **2 days** and keep **10 days**.

The current rule (from the November 17, 2025 announcement by Tessa Nguyen, Director of People Operations) raised the carryover limit to **10 days (80 hours)** starting with the rollover from 2025 into 2026, replacing the older 5-day limit in Section 5 of the PTO policy. PTO above that limit is still forfeited on December 31, except where state law doesn't permit forfeiture.

**Deadline for the days you keep:** carried-over PTO must be used by **June 30** of the year you carry it into — so your 10 carried days must be used by June 30, 2027.

One caveat: the announcement is addressed to "All US employees" and notes the Netherlands addendum is unaffected, so if you're outside the US, different local rules may apply.
